01-book-3d.title: Studio Product Showcase
01-book-3d.example_prompt:
Motion transfer. Take ONLY the camera movement, the object's rotation, the timing and the cut rhythm from the reference video. Do not take anything else from it: not the mouse design, not its logo or text, not its lights, not its colors, not its background.

Subject: the black wireless gaming mouse from the reference images: matte black shell, split main buttons at the front, two black side buttons on the left side, black scroll wheel with a white inner ring, one tiny cyan indicator light on top behind the main buttons, and a light grey "ATTACK SHARK" logo with a small fin icon on the left side near the front. Image 1 is the three-quarter view from the front left. Image 2 is the exact top view. Do not invent details on any side that is not visible in the images: keep those surfaces plain matte black.

Scene: in shots 1 and 2 the mouse floats and turns in the air exactly like the reference. In shot 3, seen from above, the mouse lies flat on the surface with a soft shadow directly underneath. The mouse is the only object. Seamless very light grey studio background with no visible horizon, soft even lighting, and one crisp highlight along the shell so the black shape reads clearly.

Look: clean premium tech commercial, whole product in sharp focus, smooth stabilized motion. Same shape, proportions, button count, logo text and logo placement in every frame.

Ending: finish on a steady shot of the product. No fade out, no dimming, no end card.

Negative: light strip on the mouse, RGB ring, RGB lighting, red scroll wheel, glossy shell, sticker, label, underside, any brand text other than ATTACK SHARK, distorted logo, misspelled text, extra logos, logo on the wrong side, on-screen text, subtitles, watermark, invented ports, invented seams, extra panels, warped shell, morphing object, changing proportions, extra or missing buttons, charging dock, cable, hands, people, extra objects, product standing upright, dark background, fade to black, flicker, jitter, blurry, CGI look, cartoon, cropped subject
